raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
context:
  name: uarray
  version: "0.9.5"
  python_min: "3.12"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 1ea6fbc4ffa82462227991477ef5f82415eb21f364ab02a677f54003755757af

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - if: not win
      then: build_base.sh
      else: build_base.bat

  skip: match(python, "<${{ python_min }}")

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python ${{ python }}
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ninja
  host:
    - python ${{ python }}
    - versioningit
    - meson-python
    - pip
    - python-build
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - uarray
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
    script:
      - pip check

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A backend-dispatch mechanism for Python.
  description: |
    `uarray` is a backend-dispatch mechanism for Python.
  homepage: https://github.com/Quansight-Labs/uarray
  repository: https://github.com/Quansight-Labs/uarray
  documentation: http://uarray.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hameerabbasi
